row.body: The directory is folded into a lost-property wallet; its receipt says the meeting point was cleared before the last bus reached the entrance.
row.title: A mall meeting point

sidecar.gloss: The meeting point is cleared before its last bus arrives.
sidecar.rival_reading: A promotional crew could have cleared the meeting point for ordinary closing; the receipt does not say who waited for the bus.
